Use compatible optional backend query interfaces; update OpenAPI/schema/C#/TS clients together. Include tests/docs, no whole-fleet query in Next.

workItems.title: Independent portal host and OIDC session boundary
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Backoffice: add independent Next/TypeScript host using supported exact dependency pins and maintained OIDC code/PKCE session adapter. Management tokens remain server-only with secure HttpOnly cookies, callback/state/nonce/PKCE and origin/redirect controls, expiry/sign-out/revocation, per-request credentials and cancellation. Portable packages remain framework-free. Public responses traverse explicit cache policy (auth no-store); health has no database I/O, auth uses only the maintained owned session adapter with no direct Management repository access; no auth/test framework. Tests/docs/license notices included.
workItems.validation: Focused host/session tests and build verify request isolation, denied browser token APIs, authenticated access, expiry/revocation, callback/return validation, origin/CSRF rules and cancellation. Check current supported versions/licenses and physical storage before install/build. Document separate owned session schema and local-versus-live identity evidence. Independent review checks responsibility expansion.

workItems.title: Approved desktop inspection UI and connected behavior
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Backoffice: implement approved R06 Applications filters, selected-app Instances/Configuration/Capabilities/Scheduled jobs, read-only quick panels and Job Overview/local Configuration. Keep app/env/registration/report/scoped identities and reported versions; truthful Not reported/unknown/unavailable states. Run history and Task/Event APIs unavailable until RM10; no synthetic production records or inferred cron/bindings. Abort stale reads, clear denied session state, preserve keyboard/Escape/focus/context. Include runnable docs/tests/review; no new journeys. The typed portal-model/API routes and SDK contracts are now frozen handoffs, so UI source may proceed independently after WORK001. Connected acceptance and completion still require WORK002/003/004 completed with current native evidence; no backend/session check is waived.
workItems.validation: Focused UI and existing connected native/provider tests prove bounded paging, per-registration versions, definition metadata only, inventory identity, target switching/cancellation/stale response, denial/session expiry and panel keyboard/focus behavior. Actual desktop screenshots compared with approved R06; material new journey requires screenshot review. Build affected clients/portal, record proof limits and native costs; no broad qualification campaign. Before completion, verify native WORK002/003/004 are Complete and reference their actual current focused evidence, then validate the connected UI. Source work may run in parallel against the frozen DTO/API handoff.

workItems.title: Interactive local portal fixture with synthetic test data
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Reuse the existing named native portal fixture for an explicit opt-in loopback interactive session with isolated synthetic applications, instances, configuration metadata and Jobs reports. Ordinary production host and genuine controlled-issuer OIDC/PKCE/native grants remain unchanged. Provide visible isolated test browser, safe ready URL/status, explicit stop control, finite maximum four-hour session, sequential startup and joined owned provider/schema/key/browser cleanup. No production demo mode, installed trust, framework, external deployment, push or merge. User explicitly requested local test-data setup after desktop delivery; existing standing authority delegates bounded routine setup.
workItems.validation: Build/format changed C#, syntax/policy tests and real manual-mode smoke including sign-in, both application rows, per-instance versions, metadata/Jobs and stop drainage. Launch final interactive session and verify ready; keep ownership active through its finite lease. Independent review checks auth isolation, lifetime/cleanup and responsibility growth.

workItems.title: Preserve strict origin validation for ordinary portal authentication forms
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Correct the real browser sign-in/sign-out form rejection exposed by requested local manual setup. Use consistent same-origin referrer policy across the existing native host and Next headers, preserving exact Origin validation, CSRF, maintained OIDC/PKCE and cross-origin referrer suppression. Keep the approved desktop journey and all runtime authority unchanged. Include focused policy negatives, actual browser form sign-in/sign-out regression, build and documentation/review. No new auth UI, fallback for null/missing Origin, dependency or framework.
workItems.validation: Focused policy tests retain rejection of missing/cross-origin headers. Production build passes. Existing native26 host cases and actual browser chooser/sign-in/sign-out/relogin and native app grants pass; record safe Origin/site observations only, no tokens/cookies. Independent review confirms no responsibility expansion.
